g.text: High-order banking: words 0–3 are all in bank 0
reading words 0, 1, 2, 3 — a bank is busy 4 clocks for each access
A stream of reads waits for the same bank: 16 clocks
Low-order interleaving: words 0, 1, 2, 3 sit in banks 0, 1, 2, 3
reading words 0, 1, 2, 3 — a bank is busy 4 clocks for each access
The banks overlap: a new read every clock, 7 clocks in total
